sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
King Plastic Corporation is the leading manufacturer of quality polymer sheets, giant slabs, and massive shapes since 1968.

Industry: Materials Manufacturing · HQ: North Port, Florida · Size: <$50M · Products: King StarBoard®, King StarBoard® AS, King StarBoard® XL, King StarLite® XL, King StarBoard® ST, King MediGrade®

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: King Plastic Corporation scores 27 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by event engagement (8/15) and pain-point alignment (15/15). Nothing was found for industry fit and application fit, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on weatherability, graffiti resistance, chemical resistance, cleanability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar's low-surface-energy face makes graffiti and overspray wipe off cleanly. Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing. Tedlar surfaces clean up with mild detergent, no abrasives, no gloss loss. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.
